title: Pracrtp
description: Smooth, lag-free Random Teleport (RTP) plugin with a GUI menu — built for Practice/PvP servers, fully configurable.
body:
# PracRTP (GUI)

**PracRTP** is a Random Teleport (RTP) plugin built specifically for Practice servers.

## ⚠️ Version Notice
- **Recommended:** Minecraft 1.21.4
- **Not supported:** 1.21.11 (usable, but not recommended)
- **Recommended server software:** Paper & Purpur

## 🌐 Velocity / BungeeCord Setup
If you're using **Velocity** or **BungeeCord**, `PracRTP-spigot` must be installed on **every backend server**.

## 💡 Why PracRTP for Practice Servers?
- ✅ Smooth & clean teleportation, no stutter
- ✅ Low CPU/RAM usage — won't drag down your TPS
- ✅ Deep configuration options tailored for practice servers

## 📸 Preview
![PracRTP GUI Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f140e74fec57e9204d4c9e79b45ca4e078837980.png)
![PracRTP In-Game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4469e7af8a5ce91e06ca363afb3022bf17aa5877.png)

## 📥 Installation
1. Download the `.jar` file
2. Place it into your server's `/plugins` folder
3. (Velocity/BungeeCord users) Also install on every backend server
4. Restart the server
5. Configure `config.yml` as needed

## 💬 Support
Found a bug or have a suggestion? Let us know Send to Discord.
